coreReview.reason: Distinguish parallel heads within a layer from successive layers and explain their combination.
Connect repeated state updates, recurrent feedback and layer-by-layer transformation without conflating their trajectories.
Explain the shared next-item prediction problem across different kinds of vector data.
Use constrained next-letter choices as evidence about learned English patterns.

guide.title: Separate heads, layers and agents
guide.explanation: Explain what happens in parallel within a layer, what happens successively across layers and what happens between separate LLMs in a critique-and-revision graph.

guide.title: Follow changing state through a rule
guide.explanation: Read the oscillator updates in order, explain how copied output carries information into a recurrent state and describe depth as the LLM comparison to time. Predict directions of change without working numerical exercises.

guide.title: Identify what the vectors represent
guide.explanation: Map words, spectrogram frames, image patches and amino acids to the ordered sequence and its missing next item. Distinguish shared prediction structure from the different data being represented.

guide.title: Explain why the next letter is constrained
guide.explanation: Use sound-based CVC syllables, onset and coda ordering and syllable boundaries to explain the contrast between open and restricted continuations in the next-letter task.
